note: Slice 2 of the codex/m3-production-phase1 merge (MERGE-PLAN.md Part 5): main..0d17ad0085a2a6b365448637d9dbdccb6d20871c..70420856a481b2e586f6074b53f46bd4f0ef6693, pinned after the plan's own SHA (c9da7226) because one more commit (70420856) landed on the branch before this slice was opened, exactly as the plan's 'keeping this current' note anticipated -- folded into this slice rather than a new one, since it is the same night's integration work and touches the same live files. Covers: the provision_instance_id claims-scoping fix, the termination-fee card-attribution fix, three compare-mode bug fixes, the MAE pill relabel and carve-out identity dedup, the per-family V2 serving switch (termination fees) with its own production-excluding runtime gate, the V1/V2 side-by-side compare mode (also gated, strictly narrower than serving), five provision tables' card-selection leaks fixed, the conditional termination-fee amount projection, three first-number-wins money-parser fixes, amendment/restatement classification in the EDGAR discovery pipeline, find-in-page clause-text toggle, print stylesheet, a Vercel file-tracing fix for a fixture the canonical termination-fee source reads at runtime, retirement of the dead /compare page, and the documentation archive move. See MERGE-PLAN.md Part 2 and Part 5, and this PR's description for the fourteen-plus-one commits read in full. Merged on top (not rebased) 2396bf50c1573d430b00415c6da23c5e5e56ea5e, brought in from codex/m3-production-phase1 to fix the CI-only test-and-build failure this branch was hitting: four dark-bridge suites enabled the canonical-v2 gate's flag in an ambient environment but left CI set, and the gate refuses whenever CI is truthy, so they passed on a developer machine and could never pass on GitHub Actions. That commit also adds this application's first authentication (session-cookie, HMAC-signed, HTTP-only, default-deny across all routes -- lib/auth/**, middleware.js, pages/login.js, pages/api/auth/**) and repairs four routes a July security review graded critical by moving their contained implementations under lib/broad-corpus/contained-routes/** (SSRF restricted to SEC domains with redirect-hop revalidation; two admin self-grants no longer read privilege from the request body), leaving pages/api/admin/reprocess-cond.js, pages/api/ingest/from-url.js and pages/api/users.js as thin route handlers. Also newly covered: lib/parse-money.js (the shared dollar-amount parser consolidating six previously-independent implementations), lib/edit-schema.js, lib/percent-of-deal.js, and components/review/table-logic.js. No commit in the original range is reordered, rebased, or rewritten; 2396bf50 is merged in as a second parent.
